subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder playbook, security kickoff & procurement asks
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: James Li <james.li@lumospay.com>, LumosPay Procurement <procurement@lumospay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder playbook, security kickoff & procurement asks

Hi James / team —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align internally on owners and timeline. I captured the items we agreed and where we need input from LumosPay.

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Use case: customer support summarization and fraud flagging for transaction notes (P0).
- Target throughput: ~40 req/s peak, typical 12–15 req/s.
- Latency requirement: 200–350ms p95 for inline scoring.
- Data sensitivity: production PII in transcripts; LumosPay prefers private deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed VPC.

Action items / owners (proposed):
1) Confirm economic buyer & procurement timeline — James / Procurement
2) Security intake questionnaire — LumosPay Security (Anita) to confirm systems in scope; Redwood to return completed questionnaire and evidence — Karthik (security lead)
3) Contract / SOW redline & SLA asks — Priyom (legal/sales ops) to own initial draft after procurement signals
4) Technical follow-up: model sizing and deployment recommendations — Mateo / Redwood infra

Requests from your side:
- Please populate the attached procurement questionnaire (one tab covers security/infra; the other covers commercial flow).
- Confirm the preferred procurement contact and whether a master DPA is required.
- Tentative procurement timeline / go/no-go date (week-of or quarter).

I've attached the demo deck and a short procurement questionnaire for your team to route.

Next meeting: propose Wed 5/20 10:00am PT for a security intake with Anita + platform owners. If that doesn't work, send 2 slots and we will accommodate.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to walk the questionnaire.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF), lumospay-procurement-questions.xlsx (XLSX)
From: James Li <james.li@lumospay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumosPay Procurement <procurement@lumospay.com>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@lumospay.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Stakeholder playbook, security kickoff & procurement asks

Thanks Mateo — good demo and clear notes. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Economic buyer / timeline: CFO (Sarah Peng) owns budget approval. Procurement timeline is typical for us: initial vendor review -> security intake -> commercial term sheet -> procurement review -> exec sign-off. We are targeting a decision window in the first week of June but that depends on security scope.

2) Security scope: Anita will lead the technical intake. For now, systems in scope are:
   - Production transaction DB (Postgres RDS) — data plane
   - Customer-facing support UI (React) — where LLM responses are surfaced
   - S3 archival for audit logs (encrypted)

Anita, can you confirm whether any internal tooling (e.g., admin dashboards) are in scope?

3) Evidence: we will need SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and a DPA.

I attached our procurement questions; I'll ask Procurement to fill timeline fields and return.

Slots: Wed 5/20 10am PT is ok for now — please send calendar invite.

—
James Li
Senior Product Manager — Risk & Ops
LumosPay
james.li@lumospay.com | +1 (415) 777-0022

Hi all — thanks for the summary. A couple notes from security perspective:

- Systems in scope: confirm that admin tooling is OUT of scope for initial evaluation. In-scope are the three James listed (RDS, support UI, S3).
- Data residency: must be US-only for production PII; non-prod can be across regions but will need a separate risk assessment.
- Acceptable evidence: SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary, and encryption-in-transit details.
- Questionnaire: please complete the security questionnaire with as much detail as possible — for infra pieces, include network diagrams and flow of data to Redwood endpoints.

I can run the kickoff on Wed 5/20 10:00am PT and will invite the engineering owners (backend lead + infra).

Anita Rao
Head of Security Engineering
LumosPay
anita.rao@lumospay.com

Anita / James —

Appreciate the detailed scope. Quick notes from Redwood security side so the kickoff can be productive tomorrow:

- We will pre-fill our Security Questionnaire sections that map to infrastructure and controls (SOC2, encryption, incident response). I'll attach a short evidence pack (SOC2 summary + network diagram).
- For production PII handling we recommend Redwood Dedicated in your preferred cloud region with a customer VPC peering setup. That preserves key custody options and avoids egress of raw data to multi-tenant endpoints.
- If procurement requires a demo deployment of a redacted dataset we can provide a short PoC (2–3 weeks) scoped to support UI flows — low-cost evaluation via a time-boxed Dedicated environment.
- Priyom — when we get procurement signal we should align on a one-page SOW template and standard SLAs to speed approval.

Looking forward to tomorrow's kickoff; I'll join with the evidence pack and a proposed deployment diagram.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
